snippet.title: ⛰️ Mafate — The Wonder of a Place That Inspired Our Game
snippet.description:
Explore Mafate through the eyes of its creators. ✨

MAFATE was born from the sense of wonder we felt while walking the trails of Mafate’s cirque, on Réunion Island.
Before becoming a video game, it was first and foremost the memory of a hike that deeply left its mark on us.

In this Devlog, the entire Blue Ramen team takes you behind the scenes of the game’s creation. We’ll share how the landscapes, the moments we experienced, and the emotions from this journey gradually became the world of MAFATE. 🎮

👋 Join the Blue Ramen adventure

🌟 Add MAFATE to your Steam Wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133220/MAFATE/

💬 Join our Discord:
https://discord.com/channels/1220312040476901416/1514653187087269888

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@blueramenstudios
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/blueramenstudios/
Threads: https://www.threads.com/@blueramenstudios

We hope that the MAFATE demo on Steam will allow you, in your own way, to experience a little of what Mafate made us feel.

Thank you for being part of this journey.

💙 — The Blue Ramen Team
